sentences.text:
Author: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
Bench: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 The Honourable Sri Justice M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 Criminal Petition No.6056 of 2020
Order:

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C to quash the proceedings in Crime No.238 of 2020 on the file of Nekarekal Police Station, Guntur District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272 and 273 read with Section 34 I.P.C. and Sections 58, 59 and 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the common order, dated 27.08.2018, passed by this Court in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch.

3. In view of the submission of learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State, this Criminal Petition also stands allowed in terms of the aforesaid order.
As a sequel, all the pending miscellaneous applications shall stand closed.

Registry is directed to attach a copy of the common order, dated 27.08.2018, passed by this Court in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch.
_____________________________ M.SATYANARAYANA MURTHY, J 24th December,
